overview: The Medford City Council met to appoint a new City Clerk, approve crucial year-end budget transfers, and authorize easements for the Main Street corridor traffic safety project. The Council also voted on several stabilization fund appropriations and updated the disability commission ordinance.

items.title: Meeting Records of June 23, 2026
items.summary: Tabled the records of the June 23, 2026 meeting.

items.title: Special Meeting Records and Committee Report
items.summary: Approved the special joint meeting records of June 24, 2026, and a Committee of the Whole report regarding arts funding.

items.title: Appointment of City Clerk
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Laurel Siegel as City Clerk for a term expiring August 1, 2029.

items.title: Resolution Regarding MBTA Bus Redesign Meetings
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration use all communication channels to notify residents of upcoming MBTA bus network redesign meetings.

items.title: Resolution Investigating Auto Pay Options
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to investigate an automatic payment option for city bills to allow for further direct research with residents and staff.

items.title: Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities Ordinance
items.summary: Approved on first reading an updated ordinance establishing and modernizing the Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities.

items.title: Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved stabilization fund requests for school water tanks, interactive panels, facility assessments, defibrillators, and an administrative server, while tabling proposals for a cemetery study and police chief recruitment search.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Assistant Network Administrator
items.summary: Approved on third reading an amendment to the personnel ordinance for the assistant network administrator position.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Tree Warden
items.summary: Approved on third reading an amendment to the personnel ordinance for the tree warden position.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements - Tabled
items.summary: Tabled the Main Street Corridor easement order to be taken up later in the meeting.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Ryan O'Keefe to the Hormel Stadium Commission.

items.title: FY 2026 Year-End Transfers
items.summary: Approved fiscal year 2026 year-end budget transfers after extensive discussion regarding fire department overtime costs and vacancies within the DPW.

items.title: Litigation Settlements
items.summary: Approved three litigation settlements totaling $10,649.26 stemming from vehicle and property damage caused by municipal snowplows.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements - Approved
items.summary: Approved an order of alteration of layout and authorized taking easements by eminent domain for the Main Street Corridor traffic safety project.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard comments from residents concerning administration accountability, local airplane noise advocacy, and a proposed resolution to protect non-profits from politically motivated targeting.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Building Design Study
items.summary: Untabled and approved a $24,550 stabilization fund appropriation for a conceptual building design and construction cost estimate at Oak Grove Cemetery.
